description: JVM unit tests for the new pure-Kotlin radio logic, the hardware-FM limitation doc, and the final green-build + safe-flavor gate. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003. This is the planning phase's TESTING portion (JVM only; device/DHU/emulator testing is explicitly out of scope here and must be reported as not-executable).
steps: Add app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioPlaybackCoordinatorTest.kt with a faked MediaPlaybackClient seam: switchSource to an AVAILABLE target flips active==selected==target WITHOUT calling playPlaylist (bare switch loads no queue); switchSource to an UNAVAILABLE target (FM, and offline this pass) sets only selectedSource, leaves activeSource/audio untouched, returns Unavailable(reason) — the single uniform branch for both FM and offline; play(station, queue, startIndex) is the ONE call that invokes client.playPlaylist with aligned uris/titles and the coerced startIndex.

Add app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/iptv/RadioPresetsStoreTest.kt: save/recall/clear/clamp/corrupt-JSON round-trips plus reject paths (HARDWARE_FM and blank-URL -> Rejected, slot unchanged; corrupt/blank slot reads null). Use the same test double / Robolectric approach the existing stores use.

Add app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioHistoryMappingTest.kt: Item.toRadioStation() yields INTERNET_RADIO + frequencyKHz==null + subtitle==""; RadioStation.synthForStore() builds IptvSource(M3U, RADIO) + IptvEntry(LIVE, ALL_CATEGORY_ID, STREAM); synthesizing an FM/blank-URL station throws (FM never persisted).

Add app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioQueueBuildTest.kt: null ChannelQueue -> single-item play (listOf(anchor), index 0); non-null -> mapped RadioStation queue with startIndex carried through and index alignment preserved; isDead predicate is honored (not { false }).
Keep existing RadioBrowserApiTest and RadioStationMatcherTest green (no edits unless a shared type genuinely moved).

Document the hardware-FM limitation in-repo (FR6.5): FM is NOT ACCESSIBLE — no public/supported Android API lets this phone app tune or read a hardware FM tuner; controls are disabled with an accurate unavailable state; Internet Radio remains fully functional; no privileged APIs are used; the phone app does not and cannot control a head-unit tuner. Put it in a repo doc (e.g. docs/radio-fm-limitation.md) and/or the task report.
Run the final gate from the worktree and record results.
acceptance_criteria: New JVM tests (coordinator switch/play, presets save/reject/clear/clamp, favorites mapping, queue-build null/non-null + index alignment) pass under :app:testLabDebugUnitTest.
./gradlew testLabDebugUnitTest assembleLabDebug is BUILD SUCCESSFUL and ./gradlew assembleSafeDebug (NFR1) is BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

The hardware-FM limitation is documented in-repo, and verification.md records the exact commands, outcomes, and the explicit list of device/DHU items not executable here plus the FM-limitation statement.
findings:
FEAT-004 complete. All gates green from the worktree: ./gradlew :app:testLabDebugUnitTest, ./gradlew testLabDebugUnitTest assembleLabDebug, and ./gradlew assembleSafeDebug (NFR1) are all BUILD SUCCESSFUL; ./build-check.sh OK (en/th 1905 strings each, no new strings). Whisper submodule already checked out in this worktree.

== New JVM test suites (all pass, 0 failures/errors/skips) ==
- app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioPlaybackCoordinatorTest.kt (9 tests): switch to an AVAILABLE source flips active==selected with playCount==0 (bare switch loads no queue); switch to HARDWARE_FM and to OFFLINE_AUDIO both take the single uniform Unavailable branch (only selectedSource set, activeSource + audio untouched); play() maps queue -> parallel uris/titles with the given startIndex; out-of-range index coerced; single-item queue starts at 0; blank-URL queue rejected (IllegalArgumentException); transport commands delegate 1:1; playing a station sets active+selected.
- app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/iptv/RadioPresetsStoreTest.kt (9 tests): empty store = six nulls; save/recall round-trip (url/id/title/logo/sourceType, frequency never persisted); clear empties a slot; slot clamp into 1..6; HARDWARE_FM and blank-URL -> Rejected with slot unchanged; corrupt-JSON and blank-URL-JSON slots read null; multi-save survives a fresh read.
- app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioHistoryMappingTest.kt (4 tests): Item.toRadioStation() => INTERNET_RADIO + frequencyKHz==null + subtitle==""; synthForStore() => IptvSource(id=radio-virtual, kind=RADIO, type=M3U) + IptvEntry(categoryId=ALL_CATEGORY_ID, type=LIVE, playback=STREAM); FM and blank-URL synth throw (never persisted).
- app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioQueueBuildTest.kt (4 tests): null ChannelQueue -> single-item play (anchor, index 0); non-null -> mapped RadioStation queue with startIndex carried through + index alignment; isDead predicate honoured (dead channel dropped, anchor realigns -> proves NOT { false }); a dead anchor is still kept.
- RadioBrowserApiTest (7) and RadioStationMatcherTest (13) unchanged and green.

== Test support (new) ==
- app/src/test/java/dev/autobridge/radio/RadioTestSupport.kt: FakeRadioTransportClient (records playPlaylist/transport, serves currentQueueUris), FakeRadioContext (ContextWrapper hosting a per-name in-memory SharedPreferences; getApplicationContext()->this; putRaw() seeds corrupt/legacy entries), FakeSharedPreferences (in-memory impl of the interface). No Robolectric: plain JUnit, relying on the project's existing testOptions.unitTests.isReturnDefaultValues=true (mockable android.jar) so ContextWrapper is instantiable and SecretPrefs falls back to its in-memory map because the Keystore is absent on the JVM.

== Behaviour-preserving seam added to production code (needed because MediaPlaybackClient is final with no interface, and getString on ContextWrapper is final) ==
- Extracted interface dev.autobridge.media.RadioTransportClient { currentQueueUris; playPlaylist(uris,startIndex,titles); pause/resume/next/previous/stop }. MediaPlaybackClient now implements it (methods marked override; signatures unchanged - note playPlaylist defaults moved to the interface). RadioPlaybackCoordinator's constructor param type changed MediaPlaybackClient -> RadioTransportClient. RadioRepository still constructs a MediaPlaybackClient and passes it, so runtime behaviour is identical.
- RadioRepository.RadioHistory.synthForStore: private -> internal @VisibleForTesting so the mapping test can assert the built (source, entry) pair. No behaviour change.
No UI, no strings, no store API, no radio-browser logic changed.

== Hardware-FM limitation (FR6.5) ==
Documented in-repo at .agents/tasks/radio-dualscreen-fm/radio-fm-limitation.md (summary + how it is enforced in code + what the user sees + which tests cover it), pointing to the full investigation in .agents/tasks/radio-dualscreen-fm/fm-feasibility.md. (Placed in the tracked task dir because docs/ is gitignored; prior tasks commit their .agents/tasks/<task> tree via force-add.) Verdict is final: FM NOT ACCESSIBLE - no public/supported Android API lets this phone app tune or read a hardware FM tuner; controls disabled with an accurate unavailable state; Internet Radio fully functional; no privileged/@SystemApi interfaces used; the phone app does not and cannot control a head-unit tuner.

== verification.md ==
.agents/tasks/radio-dualscreen-fm/verification.md records the exact commands, their BUILD SUCCESSFUL outcomes, the per-class test counts, the test-seam note, the FM-limitation statement, and the explicit list of device/DHU/emulator items that are NOT executable in this JVM-only step (Internet Radio on-device, FM hardware [n/a], background playback, Android Auto DHU, phone/car sync, presets/favorites on-device UI, network disconnection, dialogs/UI focus).

== Scope note ==
Device/DHU/emulator testing was NOT run (explicitly out of scope for FEAT-004) and is reported as not-executable. Commit is local only; not pushed.
